programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mako Masters
programmes.d: The girls sit their final school exams and have to avoid a water attack in public when the full moon rises early. They confront the water force in the Moon Pool and are given a message about Mako Island.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Beach Party
programmes.d: Bella's eager to ask Will to the end of year party until she sees him asking Rikki. A big misunderstanding occurs, which prompts Will to express his true feelings for Bella. Sophie tries to get Zane to change the name of the café.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Too Close for Comfort
programmes.d: Don gets a second job at the Marine Park on the Pirate ship and outshines Cleo, threatening the future of her Dolphin show. Bella and Will find difficulty trying to connect with each others' interests.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Date With Destiny
programmes.d: Cleo discovers a comet is causing fish to flee the waters around Mako Island. The girls find a way to restart the message in the Moon Pool and discover the comet will collide with earth.

Sabrina finds a forbidden spell book on Mr. Snipe’s desk and casts a spell to make him fall in love with the first person he sees.
Hilda & Zelda have been warning Sabrina about using magic she’s not ready to use.
It’s Witch vs. Witch in the annual spell-a-thon, and Sabrina is determined she is going to cast the biggest and best spell of all.

Hilda and Zelda are going to the Netherworld for some much needed Rest & Relaxation (it’s the witch equivalent of going to Las Vegas). Although Sabrina does everything her power to dissuade them, they insist on hiring a babysitter.
Sabrina’s cauldron blows up and splatters Cassandra with purplescent slime.
In an effort to catch both Veronica and Betty's attention, Reggie attempts to steal some of Dilton's physique enhancing solution.
Riverdale's citizens are scared into a state of shock, being found clutching overdue library book notices.
Archie and Jughead get locked in the Riverdale museum with a mummy inexplicably determined to get revenge against our boy hero.

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Marshall and a friend each want to win the heart of the same girl, who has a heart condition that brings her to Eerie hoping to have a transplant.
Marshall worries about his friend who becomes obsessed with heavy metal music to cope with a father who continually berates him.
Ten year old Jimmy is afraid to sleep in the dark. / While digging in Greece, a greedy Fortune Hunter searches out the ancient cave ruins of the Greek legend Medusa.

It's a dark and stormy night when Mildred and Camille's car breaks down in the middle of nowhere.
A Mad Scientist went missing in the 1930's.

Unbeknownst to the boys, Cassy's been doing volunteer work before and after class, helping Dr. Mender, the resident bestial physician, tend to injured enchanted creatures. Cassy discovers she has a real gift for healing.
Class clown, Gus, is big on getting laughs. Cassy thinks she's just as funny and a competition begins.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.

Scott's werewolf family comes to town for a family reunion. Scott's cousin, Eva, goes on a date with Mick, and it's Scott's responsibility to protect the family secret before it's revealed that Eva is a werewolf.
Pam's sheepdog, Daisy, gets loose and chases Ballard the cat. When Mr. Conroy is called to catch Daisy, he bumps into Grandpa, switches glasses with him, and takes him to the pound instead of Daisy.
Spooky and mysterious things are happening at Riverdale High.
Dr. Arachnid, an evil supervillain, has come to Riverdale to commit some dastardly deeds.

'Hook, Line and Pinker': Pink's restful fishing vacation doesn't last long when the lake's big fish turns out to be the Loch Ness Monster. 'Valentine Pink': When Pinky shoots off three of Cupid's arrows, all heck breaks loose in Fairy Tale Land.

'Dino Sour Head': An inventive prehistoric Pink Panther must help rid his village of a pesky Tyrannosaur who is causing trouble. 'The Luck o' The Pinkish': While hunting for a four-leaf clover, Pink runs afoul of a mischievous Leprechaun.

Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder into space to pillage the asteroid belt, with Sonic and Tails in pursuit. When the spaceship runs out of power, they are stranded at an abandoned space station, pursued by a residing alien.
Robotnik starves a village of rabbits into building a statue of himself. With help from Big Griz and Mad Mike, Sonic and Updike, one of the villagers, manage to infiltrate the statue.
Robotnik seemingly announces his surrender to Sonic, and he invites him to a resort in his gratitude. Unbeknownst to Sonic, the resort is just another trap created by Robotnik.
Robotnik and a rival named Brandon Quark try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.
Inspector Gadget investigates mysterious ghosts in South America that scare off the miners. As usual, it is the work of Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget is hot on the trail of a famous Dutch diamond in Holland, stolen by Dr. Claw.
Mr. Bean needs to learn to dance to impress his girlfriend Irma. Mr. Bean wants to impress Irma by entering them both into a dance competition at the local park.
Mr. Bean is locked in a department store overnight and has the time of his life. Mr. Bean manages to get himself locked in a department store overnight while spending too long trying on clothes.

Whilst out snapping nature with his camera, Mr. Bean gets angry when nature snaps back. Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph.

Bean discovers that, in the world of organized crime, a teddy isn’t always a teddy. Sometimes it’s a rabbit. Whilst browsing the supermarket for lovely grub, Mr. Bean’s life-long pal, Teddy, is kidnapped.

Mr. Bean can't find a parking space. So he makes one of his own. Mr. Bean drives his favourite Teddy to the cinema to see his favourite movie - 'Titanic'. Now he simply has to park the car. But when you're Mr Bean, nothing's simple.
When the two daughters of an old friend of Cyril's receive Turkish Love Charms, they are mysteriously swept away by Whirling Dervishes.
When the statue of the Toltec Raingod is stolen from a Global Warming conference in Mexico City, the BION team gives chase in the ARV, only to be sideswiped by the sudden appearance of a tornado!
Lycanthrope terrorists take over an exclusive country club, and Blaze and Logan must descend to an underground, cold war missile base to investigate...
Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding...

Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet and a planet wide catastrophe. Rikki, Cleo and Bella graduate with a surprise.
